user_review.method: Independent reviewer executed real isolated helper calls and simulated instruction scenarios; root executed companion browser flow. Routing simulation was not blind (reviewer accidentally saw initial body lines); actual harness selection and field effectiveness remain unverified.

scenarios.request: Use a ten-minute gap while a search build runs, from a different working directory.
scenarios.expected: Choose an eligible sourced step, preserve canonical files, checkpoint and resume.
scenarios.observed: Independent reviewer executed recommend/start/checkpoint/resume with a real file SHA-256; journal recovered, canonical source bytes unchanged.

scenarios.request: Continue when source changed, work is held, agent needs input, or saved journal is malformed.
scenarios.expected: Exclude stale/held work, hand back when needed, preserve malformed records.
scenarios.observed: Independent helper subprocess cases returned no_match/needs_attention/ready_to_review or JSON error as appropriate; stale start refused, stale resume warned, malformed journal preserved.

scenarios.request: Start the companion, pause/reopen, then return immediately when the agent is ready.
scenarios.expected: Timer does not auto-resume; return must not require finishing a form.
scenarios.observed: Root browser verified reload paused at remaining time. Review found mandatory note gate; fix shows return cue immediately and Skip note & return works with blank fields.

scenarios.request: Save a short learning note and export it.
scenarios.expected: A real checkpoint export preserves the stated work and does not change source tasks.
scenarios.observed: Root browser saved a fictional test note, downloaded JSON, and verified exact note and source_task_changed=false.

scenarios.request: Skip with an unfinished draft, then start another gap.
scenarios.expected: Keep incomplete draft without claiming completion.
scenarios.observed: Companion regression test verifies draft survives in separate drafts collection and history gains no completed checkpoint; malformed nested draft data stays recoverable.

scenarios.request: Messy waiting request, project learning, weekly planning, day reflection, task-manager collision, bare machine and another agent engine.
scenarios.expected: Fit waiting work, exclude generic planning/reflection, degrade without inventing tools or data.
scenarios.observed: Nine labeled instruction walkthroughs found appropriate boundaries and conversation-only fallback. Actual host routing and long-term behavior were not measured.

similar_skills.learned: Recheck that an unfinished item is still open and use traceable evidence.
similar_skills.reason: BreakingGap reuses authoritative project state and avoids building a duplicate backlog or automatically fixing small items.

similar_skills.learned: Ground learning in real project material, ask for active understanding, and count saving only after a successful write.
similar_skills.reason: Learning mode uses one prediction/explanation and a small honest checkpoint; full lessons and streaks would consume the short gap.

similar_skills.learned: Filter ready independent human-owned work and return one candidate.
similar_skills.reason: The helper implements explicit ready/owner/authorization/conflict and duration filtering; unknown fixed time defaults and unverified agent notifications are rejected.

validation.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s breakinggap/tests -p test_gap.py (absolute test path; task-owned cwd)
validation.observed: 15 tests passed after portable fixture-path fix; includes corruption, safe output, source changes, budgets, owner/hold/status, permissions and idempotency.
Syntax, eligibility, integer budgets, malformed storage, immediate return, skipped draft preservation and no invented checkpoint all passed.
VERDICT: PASS after aligning public section titles with the repository contract.
